# Contributing

Thanks for contributing to howtohardrefresh.com!

> Note: Contributors to this project agree to abide by our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Guidelines

- Create a separate branch for each change.
- Keep pull requests focused and reasonably small.
- Follow the existing code, naming, and styling conventions.
- Reuse existing components where possible.
- Make sure changes work on mobile and desktop.
- Add appropriate `alt` text to images.
- Do not commit secrets, API keys, `.env.local`, or generated files.
- Update documentation when your changes affect project usage or setup.

## Submitting an Issue

Find a bug? Have a request?

- If the bug is security-related, please do not submit a GitHub issue. Email hello@asdf.dev with details and we will be in touch.
- All other bugs should be [submitted via GitHub](https://github.com/asdfdotdev/howtohardrefresh.com/issues) issues. Please follow the provided template and include as much detail as possible.
  - Before submitting a new issue, please make sure it hasn't previously been reported by searching existing issues.

## Submitting a Pull Request

Fix a bug, add something cool, or make a change?

- [Submit a pull request](https://github.com/asdfdotdev/howtohardrefresh.com/pulls) so we can add it!
